identity.name: APIGuardian
identity.vibe: Cybersecurity, Hacker-Chic, Precision, Dark Mode, Data-Dense
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Terminal aesthetics with Modern SaaS usability.
Information Density: High data-ink ratio. No wasted whitespace in dashboards.
Visual Tension: Sharp edges vs. glowing accents.
Darkness is Canvas: Use light only to guide attention (alerts, data).

heading.name: JetBrains Mono
heading.usage: Headings, Data Values, Code Snippets, KPIs

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for all numbers and metrics to ensure tabular alignment.
Headings should be uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-widest) for 'System Status' feel.
Body text should be high contrast (text-gray-300) against dark backgrounds.

structure: Sidebar Navigation (Fixed Left, w-64, border-r border-border)
Top Bar (Global Search, User Profile, Notifications)
Main Content Area (Scrollable, Bento Grid Layout)
rules: Widgets must stretch to fill height (h-full).
Use 'border-collapse' style layouts for data tables.

cards.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm), 1px border (border-border), dark background (bg-card).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-xs font-bold px-6 py-2
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-sm font-mono text-xs px-4 py-2

inputs.style: bg-background border-input focus:border-primary rounded-sm font-mono text-sm

charts.style: Minimalist, thin lines, neon strokes, dark tooltips.

status_badges.style: Badge component, outline variant. Color-coded text and border. No solid fills for badges to maintain 'terminal' look.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky headers or modal overlays. backdrop-blur-md bg-black/70.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #1F1F1F. Use 'Tracing Beam' effect for active cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None for cards (flat). Glow effects for active states (box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 148, 0.1)).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle scanline overlay (optional) or noise texture on backgrounds to reduce banding.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark network data visualization for login/landing backgrounds.

server_room.description: Dark server room with neon lights for infrastructure or nodes section.

attack_surface.description: Global network map for Attack Surface Visualizer background.

tech_texture.description: Generic tech texture for empty states or placeholders.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' for icons. Use 'recharts' for charts.
2. THEME: Force DARK MODE by default. Add 'dark' class to the root HTML element or body.
3. LAYOUT: Build the 'MainLayout' component first with Sidebar and Topbar. All pages wrap inside this.
4. DASHBOARD: Implement the 'Bento Grid' (Mode B) for the main dashboard. Use 'col-span' classes to size widgets.
5. CHARTS: Create a 'MetricsChart' component using Recharts. Style it with the neon palette.
6. VULNERABILITY LIST: Use a dense Data Table. Row heights should be compact (h-10).
7. ALERTS: Use the 'Sonner' toast library for real-time alerts. Style them with black bg and neon borders.
8. MAP: For Attack Surface, if 3D is too complex, use a 2D D3.js or Recharts Scatter plot on top of the 'attack_surface' image.
9. DATA-TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, grid items).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (sharp edges for this persona).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable inside containers, but keep the grid dense.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
